subject: Request: Stacked onboarding credits + trial extension for Meridian Health
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex.green@meridianhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot extension + credit top-up request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with latency and routing controls. We ramped a few end-to-end tests over the weekend and have already burned through the initial credits faster than expected because we ran multi-model comparisons.

Quick ask: can Redwood extend our trial window by 60 days and add an additional $25,000 in credits to the current pilot? Our security and procurement folks need more time to finish the internal review, and the extra credits would let us validate a production route.

I know this is outside standard policy, so happy to take a structured onramp (commit after pilot) or provide a short letter of intent. Procurement contact is procurement@meridianhealth.com if needed.

Appreciate any flexibility — deadline for our board update is May 20, so timing is a bit tight.

Thanks,
Alex Green
Director of Digital Innovation
Meridian Health

Attachment: meridian_pricing_request.pdf (pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@meridianhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension + credit top-up request

Alex — thanks for the note and context. We should be able to help but will need an internal approval for a stack this size. Can you confirm: 1) whether Meridian would be willing to sign a 6-month onramp commit if the pilot validates (typical language: $X commit to receive credited units), and 2) whether any of the test workload contains PHI (for our compliance routing).

Tentative offer I can escalate: 60-day extension + $15,000 in platform credits immediately, plus a 10% onboarding discount on the first quarterly invoice if Meridian signs a minimum 6-month reserved capacity commitment within 45 days after pilot. If procurement needs the full $25k, I can request exec-level approval but will need Sales Director + VP signoff.

If you can confirm commit signal and PHI/non-PHI, I’ll put together a one-page summary for approval.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0142

On Apr 11, 2027 at 9:12 AM Alex Green <alex.green@meridianhealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Soojin,
> 
> Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with latency and routing controls....
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Meridian request — need exec OK for stacked credits

Soojin — forwarding Meridian's ask. Quick summary below:

- Ask: 60-day trial extension + $25k credits (external asked)
- Potential compromise: 60-day extension + $15k credits + 10% onboarding discount conditional on 6-month commit (Soojin can document)
- Risk/reward: incremental revenue likelihood moderate; high strategic value (healthcare reference), but sets a precedent for stacked credits in Q2.
- Contract/legal notes: needs a clause limiting credits to test-gen usage and not transferable; define expiry for any credited units.

I attached a short pricing impact calc (pricing_breakdown_Q2.xlsx) and an approval one-pager (approval_summary_0420.pdf).

Requesting a one-line go/no-go from Marissa (and any limits you want on credit amount or discount). If yes, I will draft the exec approval email and DocuSign term sheet.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_breakdown_Q2.xlsx (xlsx), approval_summary_0420.pdf (pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-16T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Meridian request — need exec OK for stacked credits

Team — I’m supportive of a bounded concession for Meridian given vertical fit and the reference opportunity. Approval parameters: 

- Approve up to $12,500 in platform credits (not the full $25k).
- Approve a 60-day extension of trial window.
- Approve a one-time onboarding discount of up to 7.5% on the first invoice following pilot conversion, conditioned on a signed 6-month reserved capacity commit within 45 days of pilot close.
- Legal to include explicit expiry on credits (90 days after issuance) and restrict credits to usage (no transfers).

Ben — please prepare the DocuSign with those limits and include pricing_breakdown_Q2.xlsx in the exhibit. Jonas — flag any billing or taxation implications (Meridian is US-headquartered).

Marissa Cole
VP Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_breakdown_Q2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@meridianhealth.com>, procurement@meridianhealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension + credit top-up request — Approved (terms inside)

Alex — good news. Executive team reviewed and we can accommodate a bounded onramp per Marissa’s signoff. Final agreed terms below: 

- Trial extension: +60 days from your current trial expiry.
- Platform credits: $12,500 issued to Meridian for pilot usage (credits expire 90 days after issuance).
- Onboarding discount: 7.5% applied to the first invoice after conversion, conditional on a signed 6-month reserved capacity commitment within 45 days of pilot close.
- Credits are limited to usage; not transferable; PHI usage requires a private deployment agreement (let us know if PHI is in scope).

Next steps: I will send a DocuSign with the onramp exhibit and the pricing exhibit attached (pricing_breakdown_Q2.xlsx). Please confirm acceptance or flag procurement questions and I’ll route the DocuSign.

Thanks for working with us — excited to see Meridian scale this use case.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: pricing_breakdown_Q2.xlsx (xlsx)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/meridian-onramp
